title: Custom frontmatter (extension seam)
$comment: promptless.ai-specific frontmatter requirements go here, so manni.config.yaml never needs to change. The manni vocabularies in manni.config.yaml say what each field means and what form it takes; this schema says which of them every docs page must carry. `title` and `description` are also required by manni:core:1.0.0 — `description` stays required here because it feeds the HTML meta description and OG card. `id` is required because docs.metadata.yaml joins each page's maintainer metadata on it. `type` is required because the corpus is split into landing, guide, and reference pages. `tags` is not part of any manni vocabulary; this schema keeps its old format check. To add another repo-specific required field, add it to "required" and describe it under "properties". If you extend Astro's zod schema in src/content.config.ts (docsSchema({ extend })), mirror the same fields here so violations fail in CI, not at build time.

title.description: The title of the current page. Required on every docs page.

description.description: Short summary used in the page's HTML <meta> description and social/OG preview card. Required on every docs page; 150-160 characters recommended.

id.description: Stable page identifier: the page's slug without the leading `docs/`, with `/` replaced by `-` (for example `for-docs-audit-doc-detective`). Keep it when the page moves, because docs.metadata.yaml and other pages' `prerequisites`, `next-steps`, and `related-pages` reference it.

type.description: The kind of page: `landing` for a product or section entry point, `guide` for task and concept pages, `reference` for lookup material.

tags.description: Short strings for categorization: the page's section and type.
